title: Hospital Supplies Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Clifford Hallam Pharmaceuticals Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Hospital Supplies Australia acquired Clifford Hallam Pharmaceuticals. Both supplied the non-retail and hospital sectors with wholesale pharmaceuticals and medical supplies.
body_sections.Market definition: The market is likely to be the wholesale distribution of pharmaceuticals to non-retail customers on a state or multi state basis.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The proposed acquisition is unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any market due to: - The continued presence of Mayne as an established and effective competitor (as well as other wholesalers providing a competitive discipline); - The countervailing power of manufacturers and non-retail customers; - The moderate level of barriers to entry which has allowed Exel and smaller operators to expand.
